dos: These conventions apply to workspace repositories.
donts: Workspace repositories must not omit applicable workspace requirements.

dos: Every workspace repository must extend the general AGENTS.md requirements with applicable workspace guidance.
donts: A workspace repository must not omit AGENTS.md.

dos: After the seven general AGENTS.md headings, add a ## Workspace section. Document workspace purpose, role boundaries, communication, runbooks, recovery, and validation.
donts: AGENTS.md must not leave workspace ownership or operational boundaries undefined.

dos: Store each workspace-owned runbook as a separate JSON file under runbooks/.
Require runbooks/README.md as the navigation-only overview and index for every runbook file.
Require each runbook record to contain id, purpose, owner, boundaries, and steps.
Keep each procedure canonical in one location and link to it from indexes.
donts: Do not maintain a root runbooks.json file.
Do not maintain workspace workflows as a second procedure format; company-wide workflows belong in Operations.
Do not make Markdown runbooks or indexes the canonical procedure representation.

Do not maintain competing copies of normative procedure text across README files, indexes, directives, and runbooks. Concise local context, task-specific instructions, and links to the canonical procedure are allowed.

dos: Keep company-wide task status, assignment, sequencing, blockers, milestones, and next actions in Tasklist.
Keep workspace-specific decisions and durable policy in directives.json or the applicable structured directive file.
Keep local operational procedures in runbooks/ and reference Operations for company-wide workflows.
donts: Do not leave workspace recovery dependent on unavailable thread history.

dos: Under the Runbooks, Communication, and Recovery headings assigned to workspace by general.json, identify operational boundaries, runbook navigation, communication channels, and recovery ownership. Include the headings in the Table of Contents as required by general.json.
donts: Workspace README.md must not duplicate JSON runbooks or leave ownership and recovery boundaries undefined.

dos: Deterministic validation must validate every runbooks/*.json record against the workspace runbook contract and require non-empty id, purpose, owner, boundaries, and steps fields.
Deterministic validation must validate every machine-followable runbooks/<name>.json#id=<stable-id> reference against the referenced record.
donts: Do not accept a workspace runbook with missing required fields, duplicate stable IDs, or an unresolved structured-record reference.

dos: Workspace README indexes must link runbooks/README.md and every structured directive collection.
donts: Do not infer a runbook schema from filename alone or maintain an undocumented second procedure format.
